rules.text: Price variance above 1% of PO unit price requires a documented reason.
Charges not on the PO require approval; procurement must amend the PO for large amounts.
Invoice must reference a valid PO and a posted GRN; pay only for received quantity.
GST type must match place of supply: intra-state CGST+SGST, inter-state IGST.
Bank account changes are NEVER auto-approved. Treasury must call back on the number already in the vendor master.
Duplicate invoices must be rejected, never paid twice.
